# The capability surface

**Generated by `rebuild/tools/extract_surface.py` - do not edit by hand.**

Every named control in `lib/window2.xaml`, joined to every handler wired to
it in `lib/sessions-window.ps1`. The ToolTip column is what the tool tells
the operator the control does, written when it was built - it is the closest
thing here to a requirements document, so it is carried through verbatim.

- **164** named elements in the XAML
- **77** wired handlers across **63** of them
- **101** named elements have NO handler (layout, labels, or dead)

## Keyboard shortcuts on the window

In tunnel order - the first rule that matches wins, and that ORDER is
load-bearing: it is what the 2026-09-09 Escape defect was.

`N`, `D1`, `NumPad1`, `D2`, `NumPad2`, `Escape`, `Oem2`, `Space`, `O`, `Right`, `Left`, `L`
